defect_class: scenario coverage — a smoke scenario has no verification home
construction: the name-search smoke scenario's @task line removed; the Coach's every-build oracle set must trace to owning tasks
construction_2026_08_22: the coverage map entry for 'Searching by name returns matching members' is deleted. That scenario is tagged @smoke in the specification, so the gate names it twice: once as an unstamped scenario and once, separately, as an unstamped SMOKE scenario.
same_family_as_the_original: Identical in substance to the original: the smoke set is the set re-proved on every build, and a smoke scenario with nowhere to be proved is a hole in the one place a hole is least affordable. Only the mechanism changed.
amended: 2026-08-22 (afternoon): RE-POINTED. This fixture was built to fire the retired @task-tag linkage check. Rich ruled that the fifth bar now grades the plan's own scenario coverage map instead, so the fixture keeps its name and its files and its job — demonstrating that the fifth bar can fail — but the defect it carries has been restated in the language the bar now speaks. The old @task tag lines are left in the spec copy untouched; they are inert, and the spec-preservation bar still ignores them exactly as it always did.
